samples.summary: Todo checklist items are all unchecked even though the feature they describe is fully implemented and the linked design doc already documents it as 'shipped'.
samples.evidence: All items under 'Acceptance criteria' and 'Steps' use `- [ ]` (unchecked), but docs/design/notes/notes.md:512 already has a subsection titled '#### Per-line author gutter — shipped (issue #814)', and the store/editor/gutter files described (store.ts getAuthorSpans, memory.ts setLocalAuthor, blame-gutter.ts, editor.ts showAuthors/Compartment, and the frontend wiring) all already exist in the tree, matching the description. The task doc appears to have been added after the work landed without updating its own checkboxes.
